note: The request file names the memo, requires M4A, and gives its public Recordings export path. Setup resets the exact Audio Recorder entry and public output; evaluation pulls that artifact and requires a decodable positive-duration M4A/MP4-family audio stream.
instruction: Linux 的 `/tmp/brief/request.txt` 写了语音备忘录所需的文件名和音频格式。用 Android Audio Recorder 录一段简短语音，并按 request 保存。
surfaces: Linux text -> Android Audio Recorder file
